long_biography.plain_text:
North American Shipbuilding became one of Gary J. Chouest's earliest strategic additions to Edison Chouest Offshore. He joined the family marine business full-time at 19 as a deckhand, progressed to captain and helped establish the yard in 1974 when clients sought more specialised vessels.

Chouest subsequently opened additional shipyards and developed port terminals, vessel-control technology and subsea services. Bringing engineering, construction, ownership and operation under related companies allowed the group to control more of its supply chain and sharpen operational feedback. The resulting platform supports offshore-energy customers through a combination of transportation, fabrication and technical services.
